verdict.rationale: Gusto documents an extensive REST API (Embedded Payroll) with idempotency, pagination, webhooks, and pre-built flows, plus an official MCP server for AI coding assistants (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop) to interact with the API and docs. However, this is a general-purpose REST API rather than official language-specific SDKs (e.g., Python, JS, Ruby client libraries); no evidence of maintained SDK repos or client-library docs appears in the pack. Missing for 10: named official SDKs in specific languages, SDK versioning/release docs, and independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
